fusions.name: Bursting Round
fusions.desc: Fires a spike from your palm with a crack that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets within 11 tiles, then bursts, dealing 80% of that to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Scattershot
fusions.desc: Blasts a spray of quills through a narrow cone, dealing 4 damage to everything within 4 tiles in it.

fusions.name: Rifled Bore
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Armour-Piercing Load
fusions.desc: Your piercing attacks ignore 15% of the target's armour.
